title: Email to Angela about QA sign-off
subject: QA sign-off timing

blocks.text: Following up on standup. Could Balthasar give his QA sign-off Thursday afternoon? I'd love for Friday's go/no-go to have nothing open on it, so we're deciding, not still testing.
The one thing I know is left is another pass on the old Android 11 tablet with Tybalt's fix. If it helps, I'm happy to check the tablet myself. I just need it for half an hour.
Thanks for keeping all of this moving,
